reviews.author: Jason Malyuk
reviews.text: Agape Landscaping is a great company. Andy the owner is extremely professional and always does a great job with my yard maintenance and clean up. Prices are very solid for the work he does. Definitely give them a try if you are looking for yard services.

reviews.author: debora oquendo
reviews.text: I highly recommend Agape Landscaping services. They are very hardworking, responsible, and professional. The work was done with great attention to detail, and everything was left clean and beautiful. I’m very happy with the results and will definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Sirarpi Aivazian
reviews.text: Agape landscaping has been servicing all of our landscaping needs for the past three years. Andres Oquendo, the owner of Agape Landscaping fulfills his services with competence, integrity and kindness. His prices are fair and are not controlled with greed. I recommend him without any hesitation and I am certain you will be fully satisfied with his services.

reviews.author: Barbara Miller
reviews.text: We have been using Agape Landscaping for about 3 years. They do an excellent job on our lawn and trimming ivory off a fence we have. They are reliable and if they are unable to come due to a rainstorm, they always text or call to let us know, and come the very next day! So if you are looking for reliable excellent landscaping service Agape Landscaping is the place to call!

reviews.author: Elle
reviews.text: We have been using Agape Landscaping LLC for several years now. Andres is dependable, I never have to worry about him missing a week! He is flexible and understanding when it comes to payment, whether I pay him weekly, biweekly, or monthly. My lawn always looks great when he is done, and I was actually just admiring how great it already looks with the snow melted due to his work last season. Andres is an all-around good person who cares for his client in addition to their lawns. He is extremely knowledgeable and is truly worth every penny. I would highly recommend him to my friends and neighbors and anyone with a lawn that needs to be taken care of.

reviews.author: John Lau
reviews.text: They consistently do an outstanding job. Their work is exceptional, they are always punctual, and they clearly take great pride in the quality of their work.

reviews.author: Bonnie Gentile
reviews.text: THE AGAPE LANDSCAPING TEAM (ANDY) DOES A GREAT JOB KEEPING MY YARD CLEAN AND WELL MAINTAINED. THEY DID A FANTASTIC JOB THIS WINTER WITH ALL THE SNOW. MY PROPERTY WAS ALWAYS CLEAN DOWN TO THE PAYMENT WHEN THEY WERE FINISHED. THEY ARE VERY RESPONSIVE TO FEEDBACK AND ADDITIONAL REQUESTS. THEY CLEARED OUT A OVERGROWN GARDEN AREA THAT I DIDN’T HAVE A OPPORTUNITY TO TEND TOO. THE AGAPE LANDSCAPING TEAM, LED BY ANDY, IS FOCUSED ON KEEPING YOUR PROPERTY LOOKING GOOD ALL YEAR ROUND.
